title.en: Type 511 Diesel Is the 360 kg Sprayer Without a Printed Engine Kilowatt
title.zh: 511 柴油机是 360 kg 的喷涂机，不印发动机千瓦

description.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints Type 511 diesel at 3 m³/h, 3–5 MPa, 30 m / 15 m and 360 kg. Engine kW and HP are not on the sheet. It is not the 28/32 HP concrete sprayer.
description.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把 511 柴油机印成 3 m³/h、3–5 MPa、30 m / 15 m、360 kg。发动机千瓦和马力不在这张表上。它不是 28/32 HP 的混凝土喷涂机。

h1.en: Order Type 511 Diesel Without Inventing Engine Power
h1.zh: 订 511 柴油机时不要编造发动机功率

directAnswer.en: When the site has no 380 V and the spraying window is 3 m³/h, ≤6 mm, 32/38 mm hose and 30 m / 15 m, Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai points to Type 511 diesel. The sheet prints a diesel engine, 3–5 MPa, sand-cement ratio ≤1:3, 1600 × 1200 × 450 mm and 360 kg. It does not print engine kilowatts or horsepower. The 28/32 HP diesel concrete sprayer is 5 m³/h, 8 MPa and 80 m / 40 m. The electric Type 511 is 7.5 kW. Send the diesel 511 path to [/en/contact/](/en/contact/) and leave kW blank. The page is quote-only.
directAnswer.zh: 现场没有 380 V，并且喷涂窗口是 3 m³/h、≤6 mm、软管 32/38 mm、30 m / 15 m 时，河北品锦机械（邢台）指向 511 柴油机。该页印柴油机、3–5 MPa、砂灰比 ≤1:3、1600 × 1200 × 450 mm、360 kg。它不印发动机千瓦或马力。28/32 HP 的柴油混凝土喷涂机是 5 m³/h、8 MPa、80 m / 40 m。电动 511 是 7.5 kW。把柴油 511 的路径发到 [/zh/contact/](/zh/contact/)，千瓦保持空白。该页只询价。

heading.en: 360 kg is shared with the German type

body.en: The German-type page is 380 V and 7.5/9 kW. Do not move those motors onto this diesel sheet because the kilograms match.
body.zh: 德式页是 380 V、7.5/9 kW。不要因为公斤数相同就把那些电机移到这张柴油表上。

body.en: Both 511 pages print 30 m / 15 m and 3 m³/h. The power line is what the order must change.
body.zh: 两张 511 都印 30 m / 15 m 和 3 m³/h。订单必须改的是动力行。

body.en: Diesel 30 is a 2000 kg trailer at 15 m³/h.
body.zh: 柴油30是 2000 kg、15 m³/h 的拖泵。

answer.en: No. Do not add 28/32 HP from the other sprayer.
answer.zh: 没有。不要从另一台喷涂机加上 28/32 HP。
